title: Escalate to destruction
purpose: Record a later destruction instruction when a No further use withdrawal is in effect.
summary: Record a later destruction instruction when a No further use withdrawal is in effect. Managers and administrators only.

tasks.title: Record the instruction
steps: Enter [[Effective on]], [[Received at]] and [[Received via]], and the [[Reason]].

tasks.title: Then request disposal
steps: On the consent, open More and choose Request disposal of held specimens.

good_to_know: The original withdrawal stays in effect with its holds.
It can be recorded once for each withdrawal.
Nothing is disposed until each disposal request is approved and recorded.

sections.title: Original withdrawal
paragraphs: The form shows the consent's participant and study, the original withdrawal kind, its effective date and when the repository received it.

sections.title: Fields

items.label: Effective on
items.description: Required, initially today. Enter the date the destruction instruction took effect, from the original withdrawal's effective date through today.

items.label: Received at
items.description: Required, initially the current repository time. Enter when the repository received the instruction, from the original withdrawal's receipt through now.

items.label: Received via
items.description: Required, up to 80 characters. Enter how the repository received the instruction, such as a letter or phone call.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required, up to 4,000 characters. Explain why you are recording the instruction. The reason is kept in the withdrawal history.

paragraphs: Keep participant names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates and contact details out of the form.

sections.title: Actions and access

items.label: Escalate to destruction
items.description: Records the destruction instruction with your account and the time you saved it, then returns to the consent. The original withdrawal stays in effect with its holds and allocation history. Use Request disposal of held specimens to file disposal requests for independent approval. Use Record follow-up for material already distributed.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the consent without saving.

paragraphs: Repository managers and administrators can open and submit the form. The action is available once for each No further use withdrawal in effect. The server checks eligibility again on save.

If the consent changed while the form was open, review the current consent before retrying. The form keeps your entries and refreshes the version for the next submission when the withdrawal is still eligible.
